title: A hundred trials against the bound
notes: The same graph, 100 independent trials. The bound promises each one at least 2/(8·7) = 1/28, about 3.6%, of finding the bridge. Here 43 of the 100 find it, and most of the others cut off one corner vertex with 3 edges. The bound is for the worst graph, not this one.
ops: A-B, A-C, B-C, B-D, C-D, A-D, D-E, E-F, E-G, F-G, F-H, G-H, E-H
